bundle_path.description: Local OKF bundle root path (up to 4096 characters where constrained); server enforces root and symlink boundaries. Example: /workspace/knowledge.

id.description: Stable upgrade request ID, up to 128 characters. Reuse the same ID across preview and apply.

actor.description: Audit actor identifier, e.g. human:reviewer; this is provenance, not authentication.

mappings.description: Explicit legacy date to RFC 3339 instant mappings (up to 10000); use the same mappings in preview and apply.

base_revision.description: Base bundle revision returned by preview_temporal_upgrade; apply rejects a stale revision.

plan_digest.description: Plan digest (sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex digits) returned by preview_temporal_upgrade.

concept.description: Concept ID containing the legacy date, e.g. architecture/cache.

path.description: Exact field path to convert, e.g. stale_after.

from.description: Existing date value (YYYY-MM-DD) to match exactly; example: 2026-01-02.

to.description: Explicit RFC 3339 instant with known offset; example: 2026-01-02T12:00:00Z. Do not infer a timezone.
